description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (3.05 each) capped at 19999, grants [MAG and MND +50% (25s)], [Attach Wind with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Summoning Mode I (Alphinaud)] and [Summoning Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Summoning Mode I (Alphinaud)
description.text: Summoning abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Summoning abilities trigger 1 additional time, cast speed x2.00

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants Summoning smart ether 3, [Instant ATB 1], [Dual Awoken Summoning Mode II (Alphinaud)]

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Summoning Mode II (Alphinaud)
description.text: Summoning abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Summoning abilities trigger 1 additional time, instant cast speed for Summoning abilities, grants [HP Stock (3000)] and [50% Damage Reduction Barrier 1] to all allies after using Summoning abilities, grants [Damage Cap +10000 3] to the user after using Summoning abilities

description.name: HP Stock (3000)
description.text: Automatically restores HP, up to 3000 HP, removed when that amount is reached

description.name: 50% Damage Reduction Barrier 1
description.text: Reduces damage taken by 50% for the next attack

description.name: Attach Wind with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Wind Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Wind 3
